# trafico-cli · command reference

<!-- Generated by `RenderCLISpec` from the live cobra tree. Do not edit by hand:
     run `go test ./internal/cli -run TestCLISpecIsCurrent -update` to regenerate. -->

Every command prints human-readable Spanish text by default; `--json` prints the single
JSON value documented in `schemas/`, which is what an agent parses. Diagnostics go to
stderr only. Every response carries `attribution` and `meta`.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | éxito: la respuesta va en stdout |
| `2` | error de uso: argumento o flag inválido |
| `3` | error de configuración o de almacenamiento |
| `4` | no encontrado: la ruta, el lugar o la vigilancia no existen |
| `5` | error de red o el feed no está disponible |
| `6` | error interno |
| `7` | el feed ha cambiado: la DGT publica algo que no sabemos leer |

## Commands

### `trafico completion`

Generate the autocompletion script for trafico for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

### `trafico completion bash`

Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(trafico completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	trafico completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/trafico

#### macOS:

	trafico completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/trafico

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

Flags:

- `--no-descriptions` — disable completion descriptions

### `trafico completion fish`

Generate the autocompletion script for the fish shell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	trafico completion fish | source

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

	trafico completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/trafico.fish

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

Flags:

- `--no-descriptions` — disable completion descriptions

### `trafico completion powershell`

Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	trafico completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.

Flags:

- `--no-descriptions` — disable completion descriptions

### `trafico completion zsh`

Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need
to enable it.  You can execute the following once:

	echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(trafico completion zsh)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	trafico completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_trafico"

#### macOS:

	trafico completion zsh > $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_trafico

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

Flags:

- `--no-descriptions` — disable completion descriptions

### `trafico incidents`

List current or planned DGT incidents (text by default, --json for one JSON value)

Flags:

- `--direction` — dirección de circulación: positive, negative o both
- `--from` — inicio de la ventana de fechas (YYYY-MM-DD o RFC3339)
- `--json` — emite el JSON puro documentado en schemas/ en lugar del texto legible
- `--lat` (default `0`) — latitud que centra el filtro de radio, junto a --lon y --radius
- `--limit` (default `0`) — número máximo de incidencias (0 = sin límite)
- `--lon` (default `0`) — longitud que centra el filtro de radio, junto a --lat y --radius
- `--near` — lugar guardado que centra el filtro de radio (trafico place add)
- `--pk` — tramo de punto kilométrico from-to, solo con una --road (ejemplo: 100-140)
- `--pretty` (default `true`) — obsoleto: el texto legible ya es el valor por defecto, usa --json
- `--province` (default `[]`) — provincia; repetible (acepta cualquiera de los nombres del par bilingüe)
- `--radius` — radio del filtro de distancia en kilómetros (ejemplo: 15 o 15km)
- `--road` (default `[]`) — carretera a consultar; repetible (--road A-7 --road AP-7)
- `--severity` — severidad publicada: low, medium o high
- `--sort` — orden: severity, pk o start
- `--status` (default `active`) — estado: active, planned o all
- `--to` — fin de la ventana de fechas; una fecha suelta incluye todo el día
- `--type` — tipos normalizados separados por comas (ejemplo: roadworks,accident)

### `trafico place`

Manage saved places for the --near radius filter (stored locally, never sent anywhere)

### `trafico place add`

Save a place as coordinates.

An existing place with the same name is REPLACED, which is the only way to move one.

Usage: `trafico add <name>`

Flags:

- `--json` — emite el JSON puro documentado en schemas/ en lugar del texto legible
- `--lat` (default `0`) — latitud del lugar (obligatoria)
- `--lon` (default `0`) — longitud del lugar (obligatoria)
- `--pretty` (default `true`) — obsoleto: el texto legible ya es el valor por defecto, usa --json

### `trafico watch`

Manage saved watches, check them and run the vigilance cycle

### `trafico watch add`

Save a watch over a route, a road or the surroundings of a place.

A watch needs at least one --window (outside it there is no check and no
notification). The first check after adding records the baseline silently:
what was already happening does not notify. With --emit-initial the first
check announces it with incident.new instead. An existing watch with the
same name is REPLACED, which is the only way to edit one.

Usage: `trafico add <nombre> (route <ruta> | road <carretera> | near <lugar>)`

Flags:

- `--emit-initial` — anunciar con incident.new lo que ya está pasando en la primera comprobación (por defecto la línea base es silenciosa)
- `--interval` — intervalo mínimo entre comprobaciones, 2 minutos como mínimo y 5 por defecto (--interval 5m)
- `--json` — emite el JSON puro documentado en schemas/ en lugar del texto legible
- `--min-severity` — severidad mínima: low, medium o high
- `--notify` (default `[]`) — destino del aviso definido en [sinks.<nombre>], repetible (--notify phone)
- `--pk` — tramo de punto kilométrico, solo con road (ejemplo: 600-700)
- `--pretty` (default `true`) — obsoleto: el texto legible ya es el valor por defecto, usa --json
- `--radius` — radio en kilómetros, solo con near (ejemplo: 15 o 15km)
- `--window` (default `[]`) — ventana horaria de la vigilancia, repetible (--window "lun-vie 07:00-09:00")

### `trafico watch run`

Run the vigilance cycle.

Checks every stored watch whose time window matches now (one feed fetch in
total), delivers the events still pending and reports per watch what
happened. Safe to run from a scheduler every minute: two overlapping runs
cannot duplicate notifications, the second fails cleanly until the first
releases the lock.

Flags:

- `--json` — emite el JSON puro documentado en schemas/ en lugar del texto legible
- `--pretty` (default `true`) — obsoleto: el texto legible ya es el valor por defecto, usa --json

### `trafico watch service`

Schedule the vigilance cycle with the platform scheduler (systemd or launchd)

### `trafico watch service install`

Install the scheduler units that run `trafico watch run` every interval.

Linux: writes trafico-watch.service and trafico-watch.timer under the
systemd user unit directory and enables the timer. macOS: writes
com.aam9063.trafico.watch.plist under ~/Library/LaunchAgents and loads it.
The JSON envelope lists the files written. Windows has no integration:
the command fails with a clear message instead of pretending.

Flags:

- `--interval` — intervalo entre comprobaciones, 2 minutos como mínimo y 5 por defecto (--interval 5m)
- `--json` — emite el JSON puro documentado en schemas/ en lugar del texto legible
- `--pretty` (default `true`) — obsoleto: el texto legible ya es el valor por defecto, usa --json

### `trafico watch service status`

Report whether the vigilance cycle is installed in the platform scheduler
and whether the scheduler reports it active. Status of a machine without
the service exits 0 with a "no instalado" report: it is a query, not a
failure.

Flags:

- `--json` — emite el JSON puro documentado en schemas/ en lugar del texto legible
- `--pretty` (default `true`) — obsoleto: el texto legible ya es el valor por defecto, usa --json

### `trafico watch service uninstall`

Remove the scheduler units of the vigilance cycle and stop the scheduler
entry. The JSON envelope lists the files removed. Uninstalling what is
not installed succeeds and removes nothing.

Flags:

- `--json` — emite el JSON puro documentado en schemas/ en lugar del texto legible
- `--pretty` (default `true`) — obsoleto: el texto legible ya es el valor por defecto, usa --json
